meta.description: VAD agent team v23 — v181 PTE (Per-category prompt-Text Ensemble for the CLIP category curves): a SIGNAL-QUALITY lever on the curve substrate that BUE/CBT/frame_scores consume. The flat-in-span RoadAccidents/Shoplifting curves are the measured residual (v16 record: "next levers must attack SIGNAL quality"); the current single-text-prompt-per-category embedding is the weakest link. MECHANISM: for EACH of the 13 anomaly categories replace the ONE text prompt with K=4 pre-registered paraphrases (fixed in code, written down in the summary BEFORE any eval — no test-side tuning), text-encode all K, L2-normalize each, average, renormalize -> the category embedding. Frame features UNCHANGED (cached clip_features reused as-is); zero new VLM calls; only the text side of the CLIP similarity changes. Affects ONLY deterministic post-VLM consumers: get_category_scores curves -> BUE/CBT boundary ops + frame_scores + qscore. PHASE 0 (offline, ZERO eval spend): on TRAIN-split videos (4 per hard cat + 4 normals, local CLIP re-encode of frames; featextract machinery from analysis_v19_snh_featextract.py is the model), build each video's category curve with CURRENT prompts vs PTE prompts and measure GT-window prominence (max-z of the curve inside the GT interval vs the video median/MAD, the v18 recipe). PRE-REGISTERED GO GATE: mean GT-window prominence improves by >= +0.3 z on >= 3 of the 4 hard cats (Shooting/RoadAccidents/Shoplifting/Explosion) AND no hard cat regresses by > 0.1 AND normal-video curve max-z inflates by < +0.5 on average (curve-level FP guard). NO-GO -> record + STOP. GO -> implement flag pte_curves default OFF (CLI run.py+batch_evaluate.py, marker [PTE-VID] unconditional per video incl. early-return paths), self-test (OFF byte-identical curves — grep the curve hash; ON smoke shows PTE curves differ), then CROSS-RUN A/B on the hard-88 vs a FRESH same-session committed REF (VLM inputs unchanged but the boundary operators change, so no paired-log restore — pre-registered cross-run with the +/-0.019 VLM-variance caveat). GATES loop1 hard-88: point_delta >= +0.008 AND P(delta>0) >= 0.9 AND new hard mAP >= 0.11306, FCCS==0 in both logs (scan path constant), det/video increase flagged > +1.0. Loop2 (only if loop1 passes) full-290 net-neutrality: delta >= -0.003 AND abs >= 0.16454 AND Normal-FA rel increase <= +2%. Committed pipeline = v137 + BUE + CBT + CBT-recal (all default-ON; full-290 ~0.173); cgr/ccr/cnv/kfd/tcp/snh/snh_protect all default-OFF and stay so. Concurrency 2, never two evals. NONE of the 10 banned families (PTE changes the curve SIGNAL, not a within-video re-rank; not per-video normalization; not an abs-conf gate).
